expected_result: Allowed. Time Clock = clock in/out only.
spec_reference_plain: The Time Clock role exists solely so a worker can clock in and clock out for the day. That one action must be allowed; everything else is off.
expected_plain: The user can start their work time (clock in) and stop it (clock out).
actual_result_plain: A 'Clock In' button appears in the top bar and opens a 'Clock In' dialog that lists the time-clock departments (Shop Time, Training, ClockEnabled, etc.). Clocking in succeeded (server created a time record, HTTP 201) and clocking out succeeded (HTTP 201). The top bar also shows running hours ('Hrs Today'). Clock in/out works end to end.
replication_steps_plain: As the Tech user on the Time Clock role: click 'Clock In' in the top bar, pick a department -> a clock-in record is created; then clock out -> record is closed. Verified via API: POST /api/technician-tasks/department-clock-in {department_id} = 201; POST /api/technician-tasks/department-clock-out {task_id,description} = 201.
notes: Full cycle verified (clock-in 201, clock-out 201) plus working UI dialog. IMPORTANT SETUP NOTE: the Tech test account was initially set to clockable=false (a per-STAFF attribute, independent of the role). While clockable=false the clock button was hidden and all clock endpoints returned 403. An admin set clockable=true so the role's clock-in/out capability could actually be exercised; after that it worked. Clocking is gated by the staff 'clockable' flag, not by the role's fe_permissions.

expected_result: Returns EMPTY results. Build change: Time Clock role now returns empty search data.
spec_reference_plain: Per the v33 build change (FetchData controller), global search must return EMPTY results for the Time Clock role.
expected_plain: Typing anything into the top search bar returns nothing.
actual_result_plain: Searched 'Freightliner' (a value that clearly exists many times in the work-order list). The global search dropdown showed 'No results'. The backend search endpoint GET /api/global-search/fetch returned an empty data array ("data":[]).
notes: Confirmed both in the UI ('No results' for a term that exists) and at the API (global-search/fetch => {data:[]}).

expected_result: Almost everything hidden - no WO, Schedule, Customers, Parts, Reports, Settings. Time Clock has all Off.
spec_reference_plain: The Time Clock role should have almost the entire app hidden in navigation - no Customers, Parts, Reports, Settings, Invoicing, etc. (The checklist wording also lists Work Orders and Schedule as hidden.)
expected_plain: The top navigation shows almost nothing.
actual_result_plain: The top nav shows only 'Work Orders', 'Schedule', a Search box, and the notifications/profile controls. Customers, Parts, Reports, Settings, Invoicing and every other module are hidden. Backend confirms the hidden modules are locked: GET customers => 403, inventory/parts => 403, invoices => 404, reporting/punch-clock => 403. DISCREPANCY vs the checklist wording: Work Orders and Schedule ARE shown, because the staging 'Time Clock' role actually grants workOrdersView and scheduleView. Its real permissions are exactly [workOrdersView, scheduleView, timesheetsView] and the role is defined as 'Clock in/out only'. So the checklist's 'no WO/Schedule ... all Off' text is out of date versus the current role definition; the nav is otherwise correctly minimal.
notes: Nav is minimal (only Work Orders + Schedule + Search + notifications). Passed on the security intent (all non-permitted modules hidden and 403 at API). Noted discrepancy: WO/Schedule appear because the role really does have those view permissions, contrary to the checklist's 'all Off' wording.

expected_result: No pricing. Time Clock has See Financial Data OFF and View Mode Empty.
spec_reference_plain: Time Clock has 'See Financial Data' OFF and View Mode empty, so no pricing or financial figures should appear anywhere it can see.
expected_plain: No prices or dollar amounts are shown to this user.
actual_result_plain: On the work-order detail (the only content area with data), lines show only hours (e.g. 0.00/0.80) and part quantities (e.g. 1) with statuses like 'Quoted'/'Needs Approval' - there are no dollar amounts anywhere on the page. fe-permissions confirm seeFinancialData=false and view_mode=null. Financial/AR areas are blocked at the backend (GET customers => 403, GET invoices => 404).
notes: No pricing surfaced anywhere; seeFinancialData=false and view_mode=null confirmed via /api/auth/me/fe-permissions.
